apiVersion: v1
data:
  volcano-scheduler.conf: |
    actions: "enqueue, allocate, preempt"
    tiers:
    - plugins:
      - name: priority
        enablePreemptable: true
      - name: gang
        enablePreemptable: true
      - name: siquota
        enablePreemptable: true
      - name: conformance
    - plugins:
      - name: roce
      - name: predicates
        arguments:
          predicate.VolumeBindingEnable: false
      - name: gpuindex
      - name: nodeorder
      - name: binpack
        arguments:
          binpack.weight: 10
          binpack.cpu: 1
          binpack.memory: 5
          binpack.resources: nvidia.com/gpu
          binpack.resources.nvidia.com/gpu: 10
      - name: network-topology-aware
        arguments:
          weight: 20
          binpack.enabled: true
          binpack.proportion: 0.5
          binpack.cpu: 1
          binpack.memory: 2
          binpack.resources: nvidia.com/gpu
          binpack.resources.nvidia.com/gpu: 10
